comments.value:
Expanding on the "done in unity". I'd imagine the toggles would need to be done in vrc itself. However adding 20 or 30+ toggles would be cumbersome, so I'd suggest that in unity, creating "Physbone Groups" that you could assign a few bones to these groups. These "Physbone Groups" could then be toggled in game, but the contents would likely want to stay in unity on a per avatar basis.
However, for in terms of user support for public avatars and comfort/safety, it would be more valuable to be able to assign bones to a "group" within the vrchat application itself, depending on the situation.
Although - Realistically, you can do this now if you want, without any changes. You'd just need to record an animation that toggles physbone colliders on or off, and that animation controls sets of bones. This animation can act as a "group" so that your submenu for toggles would be managable. It wouldnt specify access for a bone group to a specific group of users.
A temporary alternative could be while interacting in public, toggle off certain animations controlling certain bones - as mentioned above - and enable everyone to interact with the remaining ones enabled. Then when in comfortable environment, re-enable the bones you didnt want interacted with in public.

details:
Currently you can only turn EVERY bone public/friends or every bone private. PLEASE add the option to set physbone permissions on a per component basis. 
I don't want random people, or even my friends messing with my sleeves. If I could set my sleeve Physbones to be self only then this wouldn't be an issue.
This could be done in unity so nothing new needs to be added to the client
title: Allow Physbone privacy to be set on a per bone basis...
